[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Color/Legends|red]] '''Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor''' with white stripes in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class [[Interceptor/Legends|light interceptor]] used by Jedi Master Adi Gallia during the Clone Wars was colored red with white stripes. The ship was armed with dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and carried an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] for [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] and on-board repair.

==History==
[[File:GalliaDelta7B-CREpGuide.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gallia's Delta-7B]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Adi Gallia piloted this starfighter during a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|mission]] to rescue a group of [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|prisoners being held]] on [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]]. Accompanied by [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] in their [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|respective]] [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|interceptors]], as well as one of [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Plo's Bros/Legends|gunships]], Master Gallia flew her Delta-7B down to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface to help in the rescue of the prisoners. Together with Tiin and Fisto, Gallia provided cover fire for Plo Koon while he extracted the prisoners on his [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunship]]. The rescue team then returned to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], which jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] with the accompanying [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Adi Gallia's Delta-7B first appeared in "[[Citadel Rescue]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series. As with Saesee Tiin's and [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's Delta-7Bs]], Gallia's ship has hull graphics identical in all but color to Plo Koon's ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]''. This suggests the ''Clone Wars'' production team reused graphics.
